title: Your Patient Journey
intro: Six steps, from the first message to the follow-up months later. Nothing about this should feel uncertain.

steps.name: How to book
steps.body: Call, message us on WhatsApp, or use the booking form. Tell us who the appointment is for and roughly what is worrying you — that is enough to get started.

steps.name: First consultation
steps.body: An unhurried conversation with the doctor, in person, by teleconsultation, or by video consultation. We ask about history, routine, diet, sleep and the family, because in Ayurveda those are clinical facts.

steps.name: Assessment
steps.body: Examination and assessment of your Prakriti (constitution) and current imbalance, so that treatment addresses the root cause rather than the symptom alone.

steps.name: Personalized treatment plan
steps.body: A written plan: therapies, herbal medicines, diet, and daily routine — with the reasoning explained, and the expected timeline stated plainly.

steps.name: Therapies
steps.body: Treatment is carried out by our trained therapist in dedicated rooms, with mother-and-baby suites where a feeding schedule needs to be respected.

steps.name: Follow-up care
steps.body: Scheduled reviews to adjust the plan as you respond, and ongoing guidance so that improvement holds after the course of treatment ends.

sourceNote: Step names are verbatim from the source document. Step bodies are drafts written to match clinic practice and require clinician sign-off.
